# FG-SYS-0008

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`backup-restore`](../../ops/runbooks/backup-restore.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `wide_permission_storage_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: バックアップに失敗しました。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The backup failed. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Pencadangan gagal. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

`forge backup` (M3 O1, ADR-0019 Amendment plan 11 P1, runbook backup-restore) did not write a complete generation, or `forge doctor` found the last success too old. `reason`: `not_configured` (`backup.dir` or `backup.key_file` is not set), `insecure_permissions` (the backup directory or the state copy directory is reachable by group or others, is not owned by the forge account, or is a symlink; `path`, `mode`), `key_inside_backup` (the key file or the state copy directory lies inside `backup.dir`: a stolen backup would carry its own key or its own state copy), `backup_running` (`<backup.dir>/.lock` exists: another `forge backup` runs, or one was killed — see the runbook), `db_tool_missing` (the pgBackRest binary `backup.pgbackrest_bin` does not exist), `db_backup_failed` (pgBackRest exited non-zero; `exit_code`, the redacted head of `stderr`), `db_backup_timeout` (pgBackRest ran past `backup.db_timeout_secs`; its process was killed), `db_backup_unexpected` (`pgbackrest info` did not name a backup), `repository_copy_failed` (reading a repository or writing the archive failed; `repo_id`, `operation`), `repository_copy_inconsistent` (`git fsck --connectivity-only` of the copied repository failed three times: a maintenance gc replaced packs while it was copied), `repository_copy_timeout` (the copy ran past `backup.repo_timeout_secs`), `storage_io` (creating, renaming or rotating a generation failed; `operation`), and from doctor `never` (no complete generation in `backup.dir`) / `overdue` (the newest is older than `backup.max_age_hours`). A wrong key file is FG-SYS-0002 `config_key=backup.key_file`. The database step runs first: when a later step fails, pgBackRest holds a database backup that no forge generation lists (it expires with the pgBackRest retention). A failed run leaves `<generation>.partial`; the next run removes it.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Filter logs by error_code=FG-SYS-0008: `reason`, `generation`, `request_id`, and per reason `path` / `mode`, `exit_code` / `stderr`, `repo_id` / `operation`. `forge doctor` (`backup.last_success`, `backup.state_copy`) shows the newest generation and its age. List the generations: `ls -l <backup.dir>` (complete ones hold manifest.json; `*.partial` are failed runs). pgBackRest: `pgbackrest --stanza=<stanza> info` and its own log (`/var/log/pgbackrest`).

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook backup-restore: fix the cause (chmod 0700 the directories and 0600 the key file, chown them to the forge account, move the key file and the state copy outside backup.dir, remove a stale .lock after checking no forge backup runs, fix pgBackRest per its log), then run `forge backup` again and check `forge doctor` backup.last_success is ok. Never widen the permissions to make it pass: the backup holds token hashes, user data and every repository.
